exposure: umbilical vascular indices (systolic/diastolic (S/D) ratios, pulsatility indices (PI), resistance indices (RI))
cohort: The study included 195 pregnant women, divided into three groups: 65 with umbilical artery thrombosis (UAT), 65 with isolated single umbilical artery (iSUA), and 65 normal controls (NC).
finding: The study identified abnormal fetal movement, abnormal FHR patterns, prolonged APTT, and umbilical cord hypercoiling as significant risk factors for umbilical artery thrombosis (UAT), which was associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
